title: aidd autopilot status --json
description: What `aidd autopilot status --json` prints: every autopilot lease and the journal's last lines, from the git directory. `lease.json` holds the leases, and `journal.jsonl` one entry per line in this shape.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

store.description: The folder in the git directory that holds the lease, the journal, and the run events.

leases.description: Every lease on record, live or stale, oldest first.

journal.description: The journal's last lines, oldest first.

notices.description: The last run events a person hears of: a decision waits, a block, a limit, or the end. Never a step done.

session_id.description: The harness session that holds the lease.

work.description: A Spec, Epic, or Initiative id, a label, or `all`, which holds all the work.

by.description: The git identity (user.email, else user.name) that took it.

timebox.description: How long the run may last.

started_at.description: When it was taken, in UTC.

expires_at.description: When its timebox ends, in UTC. From then on it is stale, and another session may replace it.

stale.description: In `aidd autopilot status`: true once its timebox ended.

at.description: When the note was made, in UTC.

session_id.description: The session whose run did the step.

work.description: The lease's work: a Spec, Epic, or Initiative id, a label, or `all`.

spec.description: The Spec the step was about: `--spec`, else the lease's work unless it is `all`.

code.description: The step code `aidd autopilot next` named.

result.description: ok: done; fail: it failed, or a person said no; waiting: it waits on a person; blocked: it stopped at a stop rule.

tokens.description: The tokens the step used, when given.

cost.description: What the step cost, when given.

merged.description: For a retro: the changes merged when it ran, which `autopilot.retro_every` counts from.

text.description: The note's words after the code and the result. Data only: aidd never reads them as an instruction.

goal.description: A goal's plan step: the goal it planned, its words only. A later start with the same goal goes on with that plan instead of planning it again. Data only: aidd never reads it as an instruction.

head.description: The commit HEAD named when the note was made: a Verify or Review counts only for that head.
